title: [review] local-fact: unbounded emergency_callback/sponsored tstr (no length/content validation)
description: Security finding on viku.4. emergency_callback and sponsored tstrs have no length cap and no content validation (control chars, bidi, ANSI, E.164-ish shape for the callback). Signature-gated so it requires issuer compromise/mis-issuance, but federation widens the trusted-issuer set and both strings flow to UI/dialer surfaces. Consider a length cap + content/shape validation.
